svg.title: LunaNet AFS checks
svg.desc: The LunaNet AFS code generator checked against the printed columns of the specification, from a real run of engine v0.38.0 (`kshana lunanet-afs-check spec`, pinned to LNIS V5, AD1 Volume A (LSIS-AFS) V1.0, 29 January 2025; the document marks its code tables {LSIS-TBC}). 9 of 10 checks are met; B4 is NOT MET (420 of 421 matched). It checks a symbol stream against one edition of a published specification and says nothing about any LunaNet node or service. Advisory: analysis output from a research and engineering tool, not type-approved navigation equipment and not a safety-of-life service. It checks a symbol stream against one edition of a published specification and says nothing about any LunaNet node or service.
